entities.name: Ribosomal protein bL17c
observations: 205 aa plant protein; exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Nicotiana tabacum O80363.
Strongly basic: predicted pI 11.19 and charge at pH 7 of +24.1, consistent with RNA binding.
Pfam Ribosomal_L17 domain PF01196.25 spans residues 109–205.
Reviewed homologs identify it as a chloroplast 50S large-subunit ribosomal protein that binds 23S rRNA.

entities.name: Ribosomal_L17
observations: Pfam PF01196.25 detected at residues 109–205 in the query sequence.
Characteristic of bacterial and organellar large-subunit ribosomal protein bL17 proteins.

entities.name: Chloroplast 50S ribosome
observations: The protein is annotated as a component of the chloroplast large ribosomal subunit.
Plant homolog annotations place it in chloroplast, chloroplast stroma, and chloroplast envelope compartments.

entities.name: Chloroplast translation
observations: bL17c contributes to translation by forming part of the chloroplast 50S ribosomal subunit.
The chloroplast ribosome synthesizes proteins encoded by the chloroplast genome, including photosynthetic and gene-expression machinery components.

entities.name: 23S rRNA binding
observations: Reviewed homologs state that bL17c binds directly to 23S ribosomal RNA.
The high positive charge of the sequence is consistent with electrostatic RNA interaction, but this physicochemical interpretation is sequence-based.
